reviews.text: This is a brunch restaurant on the first floor of Galleria Foret. I mistakenly thought it was an ordinary coffee house, but when I searched it, I found that it was getting good reviews for brunch. Cresson, famous for its panini, is closed on Sundays, so I came here and ordered a mac and cheese bacon panini and a drink, and I found out why so many people like it. The bread and bacon were quite soft and warm, so it was a very satisfying Sunday breakfast. The price is high.

reviews.author: HJ S
reviews.text:
The location is really good. It's located in Galleria Foret, and the front of the restaurant is directly connected to Seoul Forest, so it's great for eating and taking a walk.  Additionally, parking is provided for 2 hours.
The menu items ordered were chili shrimp sandwich, barbecue grill chicken panini, club sandwich, red key lemonade, Jolly Pong latte, and coffee.
Even on the menu it says this is the best.
Personally, the chicken panini was delicious. It was very delicious. Plus, muesli is also provided. The price is expensive, but it feels good to get something extra.
The Chili Shrimp Sandwich wasn't exactly a sandwich. Because they put shrimp on bread. The person I went with said it was delicious. I just did that.
The club sandwich seemed to be the only menu item priced under 10,000 won.
I ordered Jolly Pong Latte and Lemonade for the kids, but they were a bit expensive. When I finished eating and left, I saw a bottle of milk tea in the refrigerator. Next time, I will have this instead of coffee.
As long as it's not too hot, I think outdoor seating is okay.

reviews.author: Hwang Go-eun
reviews.text:
It's been a while since I had brunch with a friend at Sécomte IVE near Seoul Forest.
The atmosphere was nice and the food was really delicious☺️
It was nice that there was no waiting and it was relaxing~
My friend and I ordered French toast, eggs in hell, pistachio croissant, latte, and iced Americano☕️

The French toast was crispy on the outside and moist on the inside, so it was nice to enjoy it neatly like a dessert, and the berries on top were refreshing, so it was a great combination🍓
I was satisfied with Egg in Hell because the tomato sauce was slightly spicy and had a deep flavor.
What impressed me more than anything was the baguette… You really need to add this‼️
It's crispy on the outside and chewy on the inside, so when you dip it in the sauce, you'll be amazed at how delicious it is.

The pistachio croissant was savory and not too sweet, so it was easy to eat.
As soon as I took a bite, my eyes lit up✨ It went well with coffee haha.
The latte was smooth and refreshing, so it was perfect with brunch.

The atmosphere of the store has a bit of a Parisian feel, so the photos come out pretty.
The sunny window seat was perfect for leisurely conversation.
Next time, I'm going to just eat bread and coffee again.
Be sure to try the baguettes and croissants… I sincerely recommend it❣️

reviews.author: Hannah Park
reviews.text:
If you want shaved ice, don't waste your time at any cafe or big chain store, come here. You will taste the best shaved ice of your life.

Another customer said that he went out after eating one shaved ice, but came back right away and bought another one because he felt like he would regret it if he ate another one. 😂 After trying it, I completely understand how you feel.

Koriya (Kori means ice in Japanese and Ya means store) offers a modern twist on kakigori, fluffy Japanese shaved ice made with carefully selected unique flavors and toppings. We had sweet pumpkin (Korean sweet pumpkin) shaved ice, topped with soft pumpkin cream and crunchy pumpkin seeds. Another flavor was black sesame shaved ice, topped with meringue pieces, black sesame cream, and very soft and chewy mochi. Both were so delicious that I wanted to try the other menu items!

The shaved ice has layers of ice and toppings, so it doesn't taste bland at all, and the ice is really soft. It feels like they carefully selected the texture of each cream and topping, so the overall harmony is perfect.

I hope this store stays open for a long time. I will definitely stop by again every time I go to Seongsu!

reviews.author: WANGYOUNG LEE
reviews.text:
We are visiting a cafe run by Inchin, who left a comment on the 100th Afternoon Tea special feed. Advance menu reservations are possible through Naver Reservation.

Payment is on-site. The afternoon tea menu consists of a Paris set on a 3-tier tray and a Seongsu set on a 2-tier tray, 30,000 won per person and 20,000 won per person, respectively. (Available from 2 people)

I made a reservation for the Paris set and went for a walk in Seoul Forest. There are two entrances to the store, located on the 2nd floor. It's like a hideout where something is hidden.

The owner probably knew I was coming after seeing the name of the person who made the reservation and greeted me kindly with a big smile. We exchange a brief greeting and take our seats.

I think the Paris set comes with two drinks: a welcome drink and a main tea. First, a refreshing welcome tea containing a mixture of two types of black tea is served.

It feels refreshing to come to an oasis after being tired from the heat. The light first feeling is followed by a slightly bitter aftertaste that keeps you drinking it.

After a while, a three-tier tray will appear. If you visit as a single person, the sandwiches are custom-made, but instead of being cut, they are made a little larger and additional items are added, so it looks full.

The owner, an all-rounder who doubles as a pastry chef and tea master, explains the menu in detail. (Since he made it himself), he confidently explains the process and ingredients.

For the main tea, I ordered Mariage Frères' Marco Polo. Le Salon O has two top-tier brands along with Damanfrere. They talk about signature poses and take great pictures.

After the photo time, we begin to enjoy ourselves calmly. I eat things with carrots in them first, but what does bread taste like? Oh, I can see that the bread here is unusual.

Next, Jambonbeur! The baguette bread is very soft and hard, but not hard, and the taste is excellent. The taste is evident from the use of good ingredients.

The salt bread is soft and delicious and goes well with the tomato mozzarella inside. First of all, this is a famous bread restaurant, so I recommend coming here to buy bread.

The cannelé is good and the bread overall is delicious, but the ones on the second tier have similar tastes. The scones (served spread) are made with homemade raspberry jam and are chewy, which is incongruous with the cream cheese.

The creams taste like ordinary because the previous breads are so delicious. The pecan sticks (austic sticks) that the owner gave us as a special service were light and soft without any greasiness.

As expected, the base flavor of the bread is similar to (fig) Financier, but the toppings are different and the cooking method is different, so each has its own charm. I am also impressed by Tea Master’s detailed set list.

The four-level tea list, from welcome tea and black tea to hibiscus tea and coffee, adds depth to afternoon tea. I also enjoyed the pleasant conversations in between. thank you

reviews.author: BRIANNA “Sophie” Sopi
reviews.text: It's a snack shop that makes tteokbokki by pulling out rice cakes. If you order through the kiosk, the menu comes out quickly, the taste of the rice cakes is just average, but the cleanliness of the store is a bit lacking. The young owner is kind, but he's busy in the kitchen??!! Haha.

reviews.author: pinocchio
reviews.text: My Japanese girlfriend said she really wanted to go, so I took her there. From a foreigner's point of view, it's really delicious, but from a Korean's point of view, it's disappointing. Still, I was satisfied and the staff was very friendly. It's good 👍

reviews.author: JH LEE
reviews.text: It is a snack bar based on Garae Tteokbokki. Crispy churros are provided as a service. Due to media exposure, we have a lot of customers, but the menu is smaller than other snack bars. Perhaps because it is difficult to fry, they serve fried chicken and seaweed rolls.

reviews.author: HJ2022 SEO
reviews.text: It only stimulates emotions. The place is in the basement, and orders are handled at a small payment machine. You have to order and bring your own food without any order. I heard two young people were cooking. They roughly cut the rice cake with scissors and gave me tteokbokki. It seemed really insincere. It felt a bit absurd so I left after eating it. Of course, the taste is ridiculous. Haha
